capture_gate: Actual capture waits at most180 monotonic seconds only for absent own launch binding. Once present, verify exact waiter→capture ancestry/birth/UID/group/argv and same descriptor/holder custody against current own metadata before the unchanged inherited core collects/binds. No fake profile-owner binding or original plan rewrite.
chain: Owner holding existing exact FLOCK descriptor
Nsight wrapper in its new recorded process group
Private staged metadata-only waiter as Nsight primary
Exactly one actual Python capture child inheriting the same descriptor

official_sources.interpretation: Use explicit --wait=primary only in the direct branch. This documents waiting, not actual application exit-status propagation; do not infer capture status from Nsight return.
official_sources.short_quote: If primary, the CLI will wait on the application process termination.
official_sources.subject: CLI --wait primary/all

official_sources.interpretation: The process ID occupies bits24 through47. Decode (value//0x1000000)%0x1000000 for both recorded global identifiers; do not reinterpret this as a GPU index or physical assignment.
official_sources.subject: Serialized globalPid/globalTid identity fields

parent_terminal_gate: Parent retains descriptor through actual capture wait proof, waiter/Nsight terminal return, positive trace and source/custody checks. Nsight return alone never proves capture return.
required_metadata_cases: Exact retained FD chain and actual one-child wait return pass in a synthetic CPU-only fixture.
Dropped/changed descriptor,wrong owner/Nsight/waiter/capture birth/UID/argv/group refuses before NUM.
Actual child nonzero/signal/unknown wait refuses despite synthetic Nsight zero.
No second child,existing launch/wait record or descriptor reacquisition accepted.
Synthetic SQLite positive capture kernel/API records pass; wrong/relabelled PID,missing table/columns/zero duration/zero rows/changed database refuses.
Default/UVA Nsight command and sampler output remain unchanged.
scope: Only explicit direct card-one profiling; default/UVA behavior and approved core80bb remain unchanged.
trace_process_gate: After existing immutable Nsight stats export, inspect only its exact hash-bound read-only SQLite derivative. Supported CUPTI kernel/globalPid and runtime-or-driver/globalTid tables must have positive duration rows belonging only to the exact capture PID. Require positive capture kernel/API counts; any missing schema,unavailable ID,foreign or ambiguous row refuses. Join with actual direct binding/process and trace hash; no zero-trace or remembered-PID credit.

waiter_entry.child_launch: One Popen of exact recorded Python plus staged profile_selected.py --capture-unit unit --direct-held-lock-fd actualFD, pass_fds=(actualFD,). No retry or second child.
waiter_entry.child_record: unit/direct_capture_launch.json; actual child PID/birth/all4UIDs/rawstat/argv/parent/group plus waiter receipt, fsynced before child publishes capture identity or imports NUM.
waiter_entry.failures: Preserve partial records and stop/wait only this newly created owned capture process/group while retaining parent descriptor. Missing/ambiguous custody/identity or unsupported core chain refuses before CUDA.
waiter_entry.own_record: unit/direct_profile_waiter.json; own raw process/UID and lock metadata, owner/Nsight/plan receipts.
waiter_entry.preconditions: Exact staged prepared direct component profile; no NUM module import; own all4UIDs/host/PID/birth, owner metadata/current source/history and unchanged inherited FD/inode/FLOCK/holder birth; exact recorded Nsight parent/source command and process group.
waiter_entry.wait_record: unit/direct_capture_wait_return.json; actual Popen wait return integer, exact child command/PID/birth/UID and parent/waiter refs. Negative signal or nonzero return remains failure; never replace with zero.
